interpretation_limits: A decrease in a diversity penalty is not evidence of slot collapse; direct slot distances and similarities are required.
Reference deficit is a transport budget quantity, not training prediction loss.
A low deficit-weighted native loss does not establish native branch activation, predictive quality, or information preservation.
A near-zero signed mean relation gap may hide positive and negative patient gaps; it is not mean absolute gap or a zero relation contribution.
Loss values and even nonzero probe gaps cannot establish effective parameter gradients or a causal source of validation deterioration.
Retrospective best validation scores are checkpoint-selection evidence, not held-out test performance or proof of generalization.
